topic: The Central Limit Theorem (CLT): The Magic of Averages

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Concept of Distribution
lecture_lines: A distribution shows how data spreads out.
Uniform distributions mean all outcomes are equally likely.
Rolling a die creates a uniform distribution.
animations: Display text \"A distribution shows how data spreads out.\" in #FFFFFF.
Display text \"Uniform distributions mean all outcomes are equally likely.\" in #FFFFFF.
Display text \"Rolling a die creates a uniform distribution.\" in #FFFFFF.

sections.title: The Hook: The Chaos of One vs. The Order of Many
lecture_lines: What happens when we average multiple samples?
One sample is random and chaotic.
animations: Display text \"What happens when we average multiple samples?\" in #FFFFFF.
Display text \"One sample is random and chaotic.\" in #FFFFFF.
Display text \"Many samples averaged become predictable.\" in #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Core Concept: The Normal Approximation
lecture_lines: Sample means approach a normal distribution.
This happens regardless of population shape.
Increase sample size for better approximation.
animations: Display text \"The CLT explains this magic.\" in #FFFFFF.
Display text \"Sample means approach a normal distribution.\" in #FFFFFF.
Display text \"This happens regardless of population shape.\" in #FFFFFF.
Display text \"Increase sample size for better approximation.\" in #FFFFFF.
Display text \"The bell curve always emerges.\" in #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Visualizing the Bell Curve
lecture_lines: Two key parameters emerge: mean and variance.
The mean of means equals population mean.
Variance shrinks as sample size grows.
animations: Display text \"Two key parameters emerge: mean and variance.\" in #FFFFFF.
Display text \"The mean of means equals population mean.\" in #FFFFFF.
Display text \"Variance shrinks as sample size grows.\" in #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Application: Real-World Predictability
lecture_lines: CLT allows population inference from samples.
We predict outcomes without knowing original shapes.
It bridges sample data to real-world certainty.
animations: Display text \"CLT allows population inference from samples.\" in #FFFFFF.
